items.headline: $FLIP Crashes 34% After $4.86M Vault Exploit
items.summary: Chainflip halted swaps after a suspected key compromise drained $4.86M from its Ethereum vault. $FLIP plunged 34% as deposits and withdrawals were frozen.

items.headline: $CYBER Warns Users Off Bridge After Mystery Minting
items.summary: Cyber told users to avoid its bridge after unexpected token minting. Upbit and Bithumb suspended $CYBER deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum.

items.headline: $CC Burns to Expand Across Canton MainNet
items.summary: Canton approved a plan to replace legacy license fees with $CC token burns on dedicated synchronizers, with phase one tentatively set for Q1 2027.

items.headline: $SKY Buybacks Outpace Revenue, Llama Data Shows
items.summary: DefiLlama data shows Sky's buybacks and staking rewards hit $827K on Nov. 20, well above its $440K revenue — raising sustainability questions for $SKY.

items.headline: $AAVE Voters Back Plan to Slim V3 Core Collateral
items.summary: Aave voters approved LlamaRisk's plan to narrow V3 core collateral, steering borrowers toward retained assets or Aave V4 while existing loans stay open.
